arabic text:
MY HEART BEATS FOR YOU HUSSAIN, EVERY BREATH
AND EVERY STEP
IS FOR YOU YA HUSSAIN
YA ABA ABDILLAH, YA SHAHEED E KARBALA, YA
HUSSAIN, YA HUSSAIN..
english translation text:
My heart beats for you,
Hussain. Every breath and every
step is for you, O
Hussain. O Aba Abdillah, O martyr
of Karbala—O Hussain, O Hussain.

arabic text:
) YOUR NAME GIVES MEANING TO LIFE, IT MEANS
FAITH AND SACRIFICE
IT GIVES HOPE TO DESPERATE CRIES, IT GIVES LIGHT
TO THE DARKEST NIGHT
IT DISTINGUISHES TRUTH FROM LIES, IT MAKES
REVOLUTIONS ARISE
english translation text:
Your name gives meaning to
life; it means faith and sacrifice.
It gives hope to desperate cries
and light to the darkest
night. It distinguishes truth from lies
and causes revolutions to arise.

arabic text:
) SAVIOUR OF THE DEEN OF ISLAM, HE IS MY THIRD
HOLY IMAM
MOLA YOU ARE MY IMAN, YOUR BLOOD SAVED THE
HOLY QURAN
THROUGH YOUR BREATHS WE HAVE THE ADHAN,
UPON YOU WE SEND OUR SALAM
english translation text:
Saviour of the religion of
Islam, he is my third holy
Imam. Maula, you are my faith;
your blood preserved the Holy Qur'an.
Through your breaths we have the
adhan; upon you we send our salam.

arabic text:
} EVERY ARBAEEN IT IS SHOWN, MILLIONS FLOCK
TOWARDS YOUR DOME
LEAVING BEHIND ALL THAT THEY OWN, AS IF THEY
ARE RETURNING HOME
IN THEIR BLOOD JUST ONE NAME FLOWS, YA HUSSAIN
RUNS IN THE SOUL
english translation text:
Every Arbaeen it is
shown: millions flock towards your
dome, leaving behind all they
own, as though returning home.
Within their blood one name flows—Ya
Hussain runs through the soul.

arabic text:
) THE CHEST OF ALI AKBAR, THE NECK OF ALI
ASGHER
THE CUT ARMS OF YOUR BROTHER, THE LADIES
TENTS WERE ALL BURNT
FOREVER WE’LL CRY AND LAMENT, WE PROMISE
WE’LL NEVER FORGET
english translation text:
Ali Akbar's chest, Ali
Asghar's neck, the severed arms
of your brother, and the
ladies' tents burned. Forever we
will cry and lament;
we promise never to forget.

arabic text:
) WE WILL NEVER STOP TO MOURN, THREE DAYS IF
THIRST FAR FROM HOME
YOUR INJURED BODY LAY PRONE, IT WAS SHROUDED
BY ARROWS
THOSE WITHOUT WEAPONS THREW STONES, THE
HORSES HOOVES CRUSHED YOUR BONES
english translation text:
We will never stop mourning
three days of thirst far from
home. Your wounded body lay upon
the ground, shrouded by arrows.
Those without weapons threw stones, and
horses' hooves crushed your bones.

arabic text:
) THE ONLY PRAYER OF MINE, AS I AM LEAVING THIS
LIFE
SLOWLY AS I SHUT MY EYES, AND I BREATH FOR THE
FINAL TIME
YOU ARE THERE MAULA BY MY SIDE, I WILL GREET
DEATH WITH A SMILE
EVERY BREATH AND EVERY STEP, IS FOR YOU YA
HUSSAIN
english translation text:
My only prayer as I
leave this life, as I slowly
close my eyes and breathe for
the final time, is that you
are there beside me, Maula; I
will greet death with a
smile. Every breath and every step
is for you, O Hussain.
